result.title: Separating Protocol Effects from Spatio-Temporal Evidence in Person Re-Identification Re-Ranking
result.summary: Spatio-temporal priors re-rank person re-identification matches using the camera pair and the time gap, and are reported to add large gains on Market-1501. We ask how much of such a gain encodes the evaluation protocol rather than learned spatio-temporal evidence. Starting from a course-project re-ranker that adds log camera-transition and log time-gap terms to cosine similarity, we train a strong ResNet-50 baseline (Rank-1 94.3 %, mAP 86.2 % over three seeds), choose the fusion weights on an identity-disjoint validation split and evaluate on the official test set with control priors. The repository form adds 2.30 mAP points, but a one-parameter penalty on same-camera pairs alone adds 2.19: the protocol never places a true match in the query's camera, so the penalty removes distractors for free. The time term of that form is almost unused; a pair-level diagnostic traces this to its modelling the time gap given a match without dividing by the gap distribution of all candidate pairs. A likelihood-ratio prior adds 4.04 points without the penalty and 5.62 with it; shuffling the time stamps removes the extra gain, so about 3.43 points are tied to identity. The prior fixes the first-ranked match of 4.2 % of the queries and breaks it for 0.1 %. The gain shrinks as the visual baseline improves (11.9 to 5.62 points between a 70.5 % and a 86.2 % mAP model) and concentrates on queries whose true matches share the query's video sequence. The study covers one dataset, one backbone and three seeds.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察行人重识别中时空先验重排序的增益有多少来自评测协议而非学到的时空证据：以 ResNet-50 视觉基线在官方测试集上对比简单对数项、同摄像头惩罚与似然比先验，并用打乱时间戳等对照做归因诊断。
AI.relevance_reason: 其控制先验与打乱时间戳的增益归因做法、以及「视觉基线越强增益越小」的观察，可能与 LVR 中区分 latent 内容贡献与捷径或协议伪影的评价问题相类比，可供核查。
